title: Omuliro Gulabibwa Okuva Ewala
intro: Kuba akafaananyi ng’ekiwonvu ekiddugavu ekiro, ekitangaala eky’ewala nga kiwuuma ku bbanga, n’omutambuze ali yekka ng’agenda eri ekitangaala ekyo ng’anoonya obulagirizi, kyokka n’akolebwako omulimu ogujja okwolekagana n’obwakabaka n’okusumulula eggwanga erinyigirizibwa.
clues: Nateekebwa mu mazzi ng’omwana omuwere mu kifuba ku mugga wansi w’okubudaabudibwa kwa Allah eri maama.
Nnakulira mu maka gennyini ag’omutyobooli eyanyigiriza abantu bange.
Nadduka oluvannyuma lw’okuyomba okutta abantu era ne mmala emyaka mingi mu Madyan nga ndira ebisibo nga mpangisa.
Nalaba omuliro ku mabbali g’olusozi ne nyitibwa n’eddoboozi okuva mu kiwonvu eky’omukisa.
Naweebwa obubonero bubiri obw’amaanyi mu ngalo zange: omuggo ogwafuuka omusota n’omukono ogwayakaayakana omweru.
Nayimirira ne muganda wange mu maaso g’omufuzi w’e Misiri era oluvannyuma ne ndaba ennyanja ng’ekutuse okusobola okudduka.

trial.label: Okugezesebwa/Ekibaddewo
options: Yayitibwa Allah mu kiwonvu eky’emikisa n’asindikibwa eri Falaawo
Yalagirwa okusaddaaka omwana ow’obulenzi mu kirooto
Yavvuunula ekirooto ky’ente ensavu musanvu eri kabaka
Yamira ekyennyanja ekinene mu nnyanja enzito
trial.answer: Yayitibwa Allah mu kiwonvu eky’emikisa n’asindikibwa eri Falaawo

outcome.label: Ebivudemu
options: Olusuku luno lwasaanyizibwawo mu kiro kimu
Eggye lya Falaawo lyabbira mu mazzi era Abaana ba Isiraeri ne balokolebwa
Omuliro gwafuuka nnyogovu era nga gwa mirembe
outcome.answer: Eggye lya Falaawo lyabbira mu mazzi era Abaana ba Isiraeri ne balokolebwa

verse: And he showed him the greatest sign, (79:20)
